purpose: One frozen-expert, program-adaptive Mamba/NVP probability router; validation selects checkpoints and tau before one final/OOD evaluation.

router.input: normalized Autophase(56), P_M(50), P_N(50), abs(P_M-P_N)(50), entropy_M, entropy_N, top1_M, top1_N, margin_M, margin_N, JS, L1, top1_agreement
router.mixing: P_mix=(1-alpha)*P_M+alpha*P_N; probabilities only, no raw-logit mixing

routing_supervision.scale: median(abs(A)) over train programs with exact-zero values excluded; fail if no nonzero advantage exists
routing_supervision.task_loss: soft-target cross entropy over P_mix and existing normalized_target
routing_supervision.utility: policy45 reduction_vs_Oz=(S_Oz-policy45_object_text_size_bytes)/S_Oz from existing frozen prefix labels

threshold_selection.effective_weight: alpha_eff=0 if alpha<=tau else (alpha-tau)/(1-tau); tau=1 gives alpha_eff=0 exactly
threshold_selection.ood_access: only after selected checkpoints and tau are frozen
threshold_selection.selection: among tau whose final three-seed validation macro strictly exceeds high_bar, maximize S_val=macro_delta_vs_NVP+0.5*median_dataset_delta_vs_NVP; ties: positive dataset count, then raw macro MeanOverOz

training.checkpoint_selection: per seed, highest validation policy45 dataset-macro MeanOverOz of the unthresholded P_mix; deterministic first checkpoint on ties
training.lr_schedule: 500-step linear warmup then cosine to lr*0.01 over remaining 9500 steps
training.sampler: source-balanced: uniformly choose an explicit target dataset_id, then uniformly choose a program within it; dataset_id is never a router input

validation.ranking: descending probabilities; candidate ID ascending tie break
